# MeasureMap { #timetoalign.timelines.MeasureMap }

```python
timelines.MeasureMap(measures, *, id=None, name=None, meta=None)
```

An immutable sequence of measures in printed order.

A measure's ``id`` is its Measure Map row ``ID``: ``str(count)`` unless a
source states another, and ``next`` names successors by these IDs. A
map states every successor explicitly: a measure built without ``next``
is followed by the next measure in printed order, and the last one by
none.

In a manifest a measure map is an entry of ``measure_maps``: an ``id``,
an optional ``name`` and ``meta``, and its compressed ``rows``. A map
built without an id mints ``measuremap_1``, which a manifest's writer
mints again should it collide. Identity takes no part in equality, nor
do the keys of each row that the row form does not define, which a map
read from a manifest keeps by measure and writes back in that measure's
row: two maps are equal when their measures are.

## Attributes

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [id](#timetoalign.timelines.MeasureMap.id) | The map's id in a manifest. |
| [measures](#timetoalign.timelines.MeasureMap.measures) | Measures in printed order. |
| [meta](#timetoalign.timelines.MeasureMap.meta) | The map's free metadata. |
| [name](#timetoalign.timelines.MeasureMap.name) | The map's display name, or None. |
| [total_actual_length](#timetoalign.timelines.MeasureMap.total_actual_length) | Sum of actual lengths, or ``None`` when any length is abstract. |

### expand_rows { #timetoalign.timelines.MeasureMap.expand_rows }

```python
timelines.MeasureMap.expand_rows(rows, *, keep_unknown_keys=False)
```

Expand compressed Measure Map rows into canonical full rows.

Rows are in their document form: quarter-note values are JSON numbers
or Fraction pairs (``number_from_json``), ``next`` is a list of row
``ID`` strings or ``count`` integers. Omitted rows are restored as
default successors of the row before them (count, number and qstamp
advance, actual length becomes the nominal length, the name is the
number, repeats clear, ``volta`` and ``offset_within_measure`` are
unset, ``next`` is the following row, none for the last row).

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name              | Type                                                                                                                | Description                                                                                                                                                    | Default    |
|-------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| rows              | [Iterable](`collections.abc.Iterable`)\[[Mapping](`collections.abc.Mapping`)\[[str](`str`), [Any](`typing.Any`)\]\] | Compressed or full rows in Measure Map order, optionally carrying the in-memory ``tempo`` extension.                                                           | _required_ |
| keep_unknown_keys | [bool](`bool`)                                                                                                      | Keep every key outside the row form, ``tempo`` included, on its expanded row under ``"unknown_keys"`` instead of refusing it: the document form of a manifest. | `False`    |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                                                  | Description                                                  |
|--------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [list](`list`)\[[dict](`dict`)\[[str](`str`), [Any](`typing.Any`)\]\] | Full rows with exact quarter-note values, ``ID`` strings and |
|        | [list](`list`)\[[dict](`dict`)\[[str](`str`), [Any](`typing.Any`)\]\] | ``next`` as row counts (``[]`` for the last row by default). |

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                       | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
|--------|----------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`) | If a row uses an unknown key (unless kept), a number in another form, a count that does not increase, an ``ID`` stated twice, a ``next`` naming no row, a non-positive offset, or contradicts derived signatures. |

#### Warns {.doc-section .doc-section-warns}

| Name   | Type        | Description                                                                    |
|--------|-------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | UserWarning | If a stated qstamp disagrees with the derived one; the derived qstamp is kept. |

### from_dict { #timetoalign.timelines.MeasureMap.from_dict }

```python
timelines.MeasureMap.from_dict(data)
```

Restore a map from its ``measure_maps`` entry.

The entry holds the map's ``id``, an optional ``name`` and ``meta``
and its ``rows``: a non-empty list of compressed Measure Map rows,
each carrying ``count`` or ``ID``, with a non-negative ``qstamp`` and
a strictly positive ``actual_length`` and ``nominal_length`` where it
states them. A row's keys outside the row form (a ``tempo`` among
them, which a document cannot hold as a :class:`Tempo`) are kept and
written back in that measure's row, and the entry's own unknown keys
with the entry.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type                                                | Description               | Default    |
|--------|-----------------------------------------------------|---------------------------|------------|
| data   | [dict](`dict`)\[[str](`str`), [Any](`typing.Any`)\] | A ``measure_maps`` entry. | _required_ |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                                       | Description                         |
|--------|------------------------------------------------------------|-------------------------------------|
|        | [MeasureMap](`timetoalign.timelines.structure.MeasureMap`) | The restored immutable measure map. |

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                       | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
|--------|----------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`) | If *data* is no object holding ``id`` and ``rows``, the id is invalid, ``rows`` is not a non-empty row list, a row carries neither ``count`` nor ``ID``, states a negative ``qstamp`` or a length that is not positive, or breaks a rule of :meth:`expand_rows`. |

### from_expanded_rows { #timetoalign.timelines.MeasureMap.from_expanded_rows }

```python
timelines.MeasureMap.from_expanded_rows(rows)
```

Build measures from full rows whose ``next`` holds row counts.

Every lane ends here: rows from :meth:`expand_rows`, which a loader
may complete first, and rows read from a score loader's measure
table. Each measure is classified by :meth:`Measure.from_values`;
``next`` counts become row IDs. A row's ``"unknown_keys"`` are kept
for that measure's row.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type                                                                                                                | Description                                          | Default    |
|--------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| rows   | [Iterable](`collections.abc.Iterable`)\[[Mapping](`collections.abc.Mapping`)\[[str](`str`), [Any](`typing.Any`)\]\] | Full rows with the keys :meth:`expand_rows` returns. | _required_ |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                                       | Description                        |
|--------|------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------|
|        | [MeasureMap](`timetoalign.timelines.structure.MeasureMap`) | The measure map the rows describe. |

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                       | Description                       |
|--------|----------------------------|-----------------------------------|
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`) | If a ``next`` count names no row. |

### get_slice { #timetoalign.timelines.MeasureMap.get_slice }

```python
timelines.MeasureMap.get_slice(start, end)
```

Return the measures holding ``[start, end)``, re-based to *start*.

Positions are quarters, as the map's ``qstamp`` values. A measure is
kept when it overlaps the range (``qstamp < end`` and ``qstamp +
actual_length > start``); it keeps its ``id``, ``number``, ``name``,
``time_signature``, ``nominal_length``, repeat marks, ``volta`` and
the row keys it was read with. Its ``actual_length`` becomes the part
inside the range, a part cut off at the start adds to its
``offset_within_measure``, and ``next`` keeps only the measures the
slice holds. Each measure is classified again by
:meth:`Measure.from_values`, so a measure cut at its start becomes a
:class:`MeasureConstituent`. Counts and qstamps follow from the
slice's own printed order; the slice is a new, unnamed map with a
minted id.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type                                             | Description                                      | Default    |
|--------|--------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------|------------|
| start  | [Fraction](`fractions.Fraction`) \| [int](`int`) | The first position of the range, in quarters.    | _required_ |
| end    | [Fraction](`fractions.Fraction`) \| [int](`int`) | The position the range ends before, in quarters. | _required_ |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                                       | Description                   |
|--------|------------------------------------------------------------|-------------------------------|
|        | [MeasureMap](`timetoalign.timelines.structure.MeasureMap`) | The measure map of the range. |

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                       | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
|--------|----------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`) | If a measure states no ``qstamp`` or no ``actual_length`` (an abstract map has no positions to slice), *start* is not before *end*, the range leaves ``[0, total_actual_length]``, or a measure cut at its start cannot lie at an offset (a cadenza, or a measure without nominal length). |

#### Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> bars = MeasureMap.from_rows(
...     [{"count": 1, "time_signature": "3/4"}, {"count": 4}]
... )
>>> part = bars.get_slice(3, 9)
>>> [measure.id for measure in part], part[0].qstamp
(['2', '3'], Fraction(0, 1))
```

### to_rows { #timetoalign.timelines.MeasureMap.to_rows }

```python
timelines.MeasureMap.to_rows(compress=True)
```

Return Measure Map rows, omitting entries equal to their default successor.

A row holds every value its measure states, ``number`` (and ``name``)
falling back to the count where a measure states none: ``ID`` only when
it is not ``str(count)``, ``next`` as row IDs (on the last row only when it names
a successor), ``volta`` when set, and ``offset_within_measure`` only
when it is non-zero; then the keys outside the row form that the
measure's row was read with. The first and the last rows are always
retained, and so is every row read with such keys. Every other row is
omitted when it equals the default successor of the preceding
measure: count increments, the ID is ``str(count)``, qstamp
advances by actual_length, actual_length becomes nominal_length, number
increments, name becomes that number, signatures and nominal lengths
persist, repeats clear, ``volta`` and ``offset_within_measure`` are
unset, and ``next`` names the following measure.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name     | Type           | Description                             | Default   |
|----------|----------------|-----------------------------------------|-----------|
| compress | [bool](`bool`) | Whether to omit default-successor rows. | `True`    |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                                                  | Description                                    |
|--------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------|
|        | [list](`list`)\[[dict](`dict`)\[[str](`str`), [Any](`typing.Any`)\]\] | JSON-safe compressed or full Measure Map rows. |

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                       | Description                                                                                                             |
|--------|----------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`) | If the map holds a ``SplitRegularMeasure`` or ``SplitIrregularMeasure``, which no row can express; nothing is returned. |
